newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS ups VLSI to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS ups VLSI to buy.

text.p: -- UBS Securities said on Tuesday it had boosted its rating of VLSI Technology Inc to buy from hold.

-- In a statement, analyst Charles Boucher said, "Last night the company reported earning $0.06 per share from $183 million of revenue in the September quarter. We had expected the company to report a loss of $0.04 per share (consensus) from $174 million of revenue this quarter."
-- The company's stock rose 1-5/8 to 17-3/8 in early trading.
